query:
UPDATE requests.messages rm
                SET cache_control = v.cache_control
               FROM (SELECT UNNEST($1::bigint[]) AS request_id,
                            UNNEST($2::int[])    AS ord,
                            UNNEST($3::jsonb[])  AS cache_control) v
              WHERE rm.request_id = v.request_id
                AND rm.ord = v.ord
                AND rm.cache_control IS NULL
